newsitem.title: USA: News Corp set to buy Dodgers - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: News Corp set to buy Dodgers - WSJ.

text.p: News Corp Ltd has reached a tentative agreement to buy the Los Angeles Dodgers baseball team for about $350 million, the Wall Street Journal said.

In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal quoted unnamed sources familiar with the deal as saying that the deal would include Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles, and training complexes in Florida and the Dominican Republic.
Dodgers President Peter O'Malley said he has asked Major League Baseball for permission to negotiate seriously with News Corp.
The league must give its permission in order for the baseball club to provide financial information about national broadcasting, marketing and licensing deals.
The Journal said that O'Malley had issued a statement identifying the potential buyer as Fox Group, News Corp's Fox Sports unit.
A spokesman for the Dodgers was not immediately available for comment.
